title: German Boudin Sausage Curry
description: A rich and flavorful curry made with German boudin sausage, served with a side of crispy potatoes and fresh naan bread.

ingredients.name: German boudin sausage
ingredients.notes: You can also use other German sausage varieties

instructions: Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and brown the boudin sausage, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausage from the pan and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and sauté the chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped red bell pepper and cook for another 2 minutes.
Add the chopped potatoes, browned boudin sausage, and 1 cup of water to the pan.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, reduce heat to low, and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Warm the naan bread according to package instructions.
Serve the curry with naan bread, a dollop of yogurt, and garnished with chopped cilantro.
Optional: Serve with a side of steamed vegetables or a simple green salad.
